spine.claim: The dread of Sunday evening is not burnout but an overdraft alert on an empty Career Savings Account.
Building invisible skills and cultivating relationships before a crisis hits are the only true shields against career ceilings and bumps.
Character and intentional hustle distinguish a calculated career jump from a reckless, disastrous freefall.
Stripping away fake hustle and transactional networking restores Monday morning agency and stockpiles equity.
The Do Over Grid proves that every transition can be mastered when you deposit into the four foundational currencies.
